nodeDescriptors.name: Dominant Colour
nodeDescriptors.description: Find the dominant colours of an image by clustering its pixels in CIELAB - for the whole frame, a configured region, and every upstream detection box. Reports each colour as HEX, RGB, HSL and CIELAB plus a readable name in English and German. No model and no GPU required.

inputPorts.label: Image
inputPorts.description: The image whose pixels are clustered in CIELAB

inputPorts.label: Detections
inputPorts.description: Boxes to measure individually. Leave unwired to measure only the whole frame and any fixed region

outputPorts.label: Colour Result

outputPorts.label: Hex
outputPorts.description: Dominant colour of the whole frame as #RRGGBB

outputPorts.label: Colour Term
outputPorts.description: Language-neutral name of the dominant colour, e.g. dark_blue - the stable key to match on

outputPorts.label: Name (English)
outputPorts.description: Readable English name of the dominant colour

outputPorts.label: Name (German)
outputPorts.description: Readable German name of the dominant colour

outputPorts.label: Region Count

parameters.label: Enabled

parameters.description: Retry processing media that previously failed

parameters.description: How many colours to extract from each region, ranked by pixel share

parameters.label: Max Samples
parameters.description: Upper bound on pixels visited per region; the sampling stride is derived from it

parameters.label: Max Iterations
parameters.description: Clustering iteration budget

parameters.label: Convergence Epsilon
parameters.description: Stop once the largest colour shift falls below this; 0.5 is about the smallest difference a human can see

parameters.label: Seed
parameters.description: Clustering seed. Fixed so the same image always yields the same palette

parameters.label: Alpha Threshold
parameters.description: Pixels more transparent than this are ignored rather than blended with a background

parameters.label: Measure Whole Image
parameters.description: Report the dominant colour of the full frame

parameters.label: Measure Detections
parameters.description: Report a colour for every bounding box an upstream detector produced

parameters.label: Region X
parameters.description: Left edge of a fixed region to measure

parameters.label: Region Y

parameters.label: Region Width
parameters.description: Width of a fixed region; 0 disables it

parameters.label: Region Height
parameters.description: Height of a fixed region; 0 disables it

parameters.label: Region Coordinates
parameters.description: Whether the fixed region is expressed as fractions of the image or in pixels

parameters.label: Min Region Pixels
parameters.description: Regions smaller than this are dropped - clustering them would fit noise

parameters.label: Max Regions
parameters.description: Largest-first cap on detection regions; the whole image and fixed region are exempt

parameters.label: Emit Palette
parameters.description: Emit the full ranked palette per region rather than only the dominant colour

parameters.label: Achromatic Threshold
parameters.description: Below this saturation a colour is named black, grey or white instead of by hue

parameters.label: Black Threshold
parameters.description: Lightness below which an unsaturated colour is called black

parameters.label: White Threshold
parameters.description: Lightness above which an unsaturated colour is called white

nodeDescriptors.name: Image Manipulation
nodeDescriptors.description: Straighten, crop and reframe an image in one pass - apply its EXIF orientation, cut a fixed or subject-aware window, force a target aspect ratio (padding the margins with a blurred enlargement rather than black bars), and bound the result's long edge. The source file is never modified; the new image is written to the worker's local cache, so wire it into a sink to keep it.

inputPorts.label: Image
inputPorts.description: The image to transform. Video and documents are skipped

inputPorts.label: Detections
inputPorts.description: Boxes for SUBJECT_CROP to frame, usually from facedetect. Leave unwired for the other operations

outputPorts.label: Image
outputPorts.description: The transformed image, written to the worker's artifact cache

outputPorts.label: Geometry
outputPorts.description: What was actually done: the source and result dimensions, the orientation applied, and each operation's rectangle

outputPorts.label: Flag
outputPorts.description: Processing marker recording how this node finished for the item

parameters.label: Enabled
parameters.description: Whether this node is active in the pipeline

parameters.label: Process Incomplete
parameters.description: Process media files that are still being written

parameters.label: Retry Failed
parameters.description: Retry processing media that previously failed

parameters.label: Operations
parameters.description: Ordered, comma-separated: AUTOROTATE, CROP, SUBJECT_CROP, ASPECT, RESIZE. They run in the order given, in one pass. AUTOROTATE must come first when used - every later step measures against the frame it rewrites

parameters.label: Crop Left
parameters.description: Left edge of the CROP window as a fraction of the width

parameters.label: Crop Top
parameters.description: Top edge of the CROP window as a fraction of the height

parameters.label: Crop Width
parameters.description: Width of the CROP window as a fraction of the frame width

parameters.label: Crop Height
parameters.description: Height of the CROP window as a fraction of the frame height

parameters.label: Subject Types
parameters.description: Comma-separated detection types SUBJECT_CROP frames, e.g. face. Leave as * to accept every type the port delivers

parameters.label: Minimum Confidence
parameters.description: Detections scoring below this are ignored

parameters.label: Subject Padding
parameters.description: Breathing room around the subjects, as a fraction of their combined size. Relative to the subjects rather than the frame, so a small face is not swallowed and a large one not merely outlined

parameters.label: No Subject Found
parameters.description: What SUBJECT_CROP does when nothing was detected: CENTRE the frame instead, SKIP the item, or FAIL it

parameters.label: Target Aspect
parameters.description: Target ratio as W:H, e.g. 16:9 or 1:1. Empty keeps the frame's own ratio

parameters.label: Aspect Mode
parameters.description: CROP cuts the long axis and loses pixels; PAD grows the short one and loses none

parameters.label: Padding Fill
parameters.description: What fills the margins PAD creates. BLUR uses a blurred enlargement of the image itself - the vertical-video fix - COLOR draws the classic bars

parameters.label: Padding Colour
parameters.description: Margin colour as #RRGGBB, used when the fill is COLOR

parameters.label: Blur Radius
parameters.description: How far the blurred backdrop is smeared. Larger is softer and less recognisable

parameters.label: Backdrop Overscan
parameters.description: How much larger than the canvas the blurred backdrop is drawn. Below about 1.05 its own edges can appear inside the frame

parameters.label: Maximum Long Edge
parameters.description: RESIZE bound in pixels, applied to whichever edge is longer. 0 disables resizing

parameters.label: Allow Upscaling
parameters.description: Enlarge a frame that is already smaller than the bound. Off by default: upscaling invents detail and inflates the artifact

parameters.label: Output Format
parameters.description: PNG is lossless and keeps transparency; JPEG is far smaller and right for photographs

parameters.label: JPEG Quality
parameters.description: Encoder quality, 0 to 1. Ignored for PNG

parameters.label: Flatten Colour
parameters.description: What shows through where the image was transparent, when writing a format that cannot carry alpha

nodeDescriptors.name: S3 Sink
nodeDescriptors.description: Uploads files produced by upstream nodes - thumbnails, depth maps, generated images, speech audio - into an S3 bucket, and registers each one in Loom as an asset so it becomes retrievable rather than living on a single worker's disk.

outputPorts.label: Upload Report
outputPorts.description: Per artifact: the object key, its size and whether it was uploaded or skipped as unchanged

outputPorts.label: Flag

parameters.label: Enabled
parameters.description: Whether this node is active in the pipeline

parameters.label: Bucket
parameters.description: Destination bucket. Endpoint, region and credentials are configured on the worker, not here, so they are never stored in the pipeline

parameters.label: Key template
parameters.description: Object key. Placeholders: {sha512}, {sha512:N}, {sourceSha512}, {nodeId}, {sourceNode}, {sourceKey}, {ext}, {filename}, {basename}, {assetUuid}, {index}, {indexSuffix}. Using {sha512} requires an upstream hash node

parameters.label: Include source media

parameters.label: Create assets
parameters.description: Register each uploaded file in Loom as its own asset. Turn off to use this node as a pure uploader

parameters.label: Overwrite
parameters.description: IF_DIFFERENT skips an object already present at the same key with the same size, which is what makes a re-run cheap

parameters.label: Delete after upload
parameters.description: Remove the local file once the object is confirmed in the bucket. Off by default: nodes such as Scene Layout read the depth map from the same worker's local cache, and deleting it breaks that chain with a misleading 'depth map not found' skip

parameters.label: Max artifacts
parameters.description: Cap per media item. Exceeding it fails the node rather than silently uploading only some

parameters.label: Max artifact bytes
parameters.description: Per-file size cap in bytes; 0 is unlimited

parameters.label: Fail on partial
parameters.description: Report the node failed when some artifacts could not be uploaded

nodeDescriptors.name: S3 Source
nodeDescriptors.description: Reads media objects from S3-compatible object storage (AWS S3, MinIO, Ceph) as pipeline input. Only new and changed objects are picked up on a re-run.

outputPorts.description: Every object the bucket listing emitted. The concrete kind is only known once the object is fetched

parameters.label: Enabled
parameters.description: Whether this node is active in the pipeline

parameters.label: Bucket
parameters.description: Bucket to read from. Connection settings and credentials are configured on the worker, not here

parameters.label: Prefix
parameters.description: Key prefix to limit the scan, e.g. 2026/07/. Empty scans the whole bucket

parameters.label: File suffixes
parameters.description: Comma-separated suffixes to accept, e.g. mp4,mkv,jpg. Empty accepts everything

parameters.label: Emit states
parameters.description: Which changes flow downstream

parameters.label: Use bucket notifications
parameters.description: Process only the objects the bucket reported as changed, instead of listing it. Requires notifications to be enabled on the worker. A full listing still runs periodically, so nothing is missed if a notification is lost

parameters.label: Resume from last key
parameters.description: Continue listing after the highest key seen so far. Only correct for buckets whose keys are added in ascending order and never edited afterwards

parameters.label: Enabled

parameters.label: Core Inset
parameters.description: Fraction inset per side before sampling depth; keeps background corners out of the statistic

parameters.label: Depth Threshold

parameters.label: Min Occlusion Overlap
